Fan-relationship tools for musicians. The $350K seed of March 2009 came from Dave McClure (then running FF Angel), Jeff Clavier and Chris Sacca; the firm lists it under FF Angel. Merged into Amplify.ai, 2018.
Lady Gaga's community platform. Seed of $1.8M 'including Google Ventures, Founders Fund Angel, Menlo Ventures, SV Angel' (TechCrunch, 2012-02-16). Assets sold to an investor group in 2016.

Ava Labs. The position came through the Avalanche Foundation's token sales (2021), not a priced equity round, so stage and graduation read undetermined. Value is the AVAX network's market capitalisation, as the a16z book reads the same position.

Dynamic Labs, wallet authentication. Founders Fund and a16z crypto led the $13.5M Series A of December 2023. Fireblocks agreed to buy it in 2025; the closing is not confirmed in a source read, so it stays private, as the sibling books read it.
Biomaterials. Founders Fund led the Series A (announced with the 2015 Series B). Public since the August 2024 SPAC merger, trading far below $1B (the 8VC book's A/B check).
